Download an official Bank of Japan bulk file

Source: R/bulk.R
download_boj_bulk.Rd

Resolves a current catalogue file name or validates an exact official https://www.stat-search.boj.or.jp/ URL, then stores the response as a content-addressed cache object. This function downloads bytes but does not unpack or parse them; pass the result to read_boj_bulk() when it is a ZIP or CSV that should be inspected.

Usage

download_boj_bulk(
  id,
  language = "en",
  cache_dir = boj_cache_dir(),
  refresh = FALSE,
  offline = FALSE,
  max_age = 24 * 60 * 60,
  timeout = 60,
  retries = 3L,
  wait = 1,
  max_bytes = 512 * 1024^2,
  deadline = NULL
)

Arguments

id

A non-empty catalogue id such as "co.zip", or an exact HTTPS URL on the official www.stat-search.boj.or.jp host. A file name is looked up in the current catalogue; an exact URL bypasses catalogue lookup and is checked against the host allowlist.

language

Catalogue language, one of "en" or "jp", used when id is a file name. It is not used to rewrite an exact URL.

cache_dir

Directory used for content-addressed response snapshots. The default is tools::R_user_dir("readboj", "cache"); it is created when needed. Use a package-managed temporary directory in tests.

refresh

Logical scalar. If TRUE, ignore an otherwise usable request snapshot and retrieve the catalogue again.

offline

Logical scalar. If TRUE, make no network request and use a valid cached snapshot only; an absent or stale snapshot raises an readboj_offline_error.

max_age

Non-negative cache age in seconds, or Inf for no age limit. The default is 24 hours.

timeout

Non-negative per-request timeout in seconds. The default for this file download is 60 seconds.

retries

Non-negative integer number of retries for transient transport responses or errors. The default is 3L.

wait

Non-negative seconds between requests and retries. The default is one second; waiting is skipped for cached responses and offline reads.

max_bytes

Positive maximum downloaded response bytes. The default is 512 * 1024^2 (512 MiB); this limit is applied before the response is placed in the cache.

deadline

Optional single absolute POSIXct/POSIXlt time shared by the request, retries, and waits. When omitted, a bounded deadline is derived from timeout and retries.

Value

A length-one character vector with classes c("boj_file", "character"). Its value is a regular local cache-object path. The readboj_provenance() attribute contains the canonical and final URLs, retrieval time, HTTP status and headers, byte count, and immutable raw SHA-256 hash, together with cache and package/schema metadata.

Details

The request uses HTTPS, follows only HTTPS redirects, and is restricted to the official BOJ bulk host. Successful responses are kept under cache_dir and subject to the package cache bounds; temporary response files are removed after caching or failure. offline = TRUE permits a valid cached response but never downloads a missing or stale file. Downloading a mutable latest bulk file does not identify a historical release beyond the response hash and recorded HTTP metadata.

Invalid file names, non-official URLs, cache corruption, rate limits, authorization failures, transport errors, expired offline snapshots, or a response above max_bytes produce a typed readboj error. A catalogue lookup can also fail when the requested id is not unique in the current page.

See also

list_boj_bulk_files(), read_boj_bulk(), boj_provenance()

Examples

if (identical(Sys.getenv("READBOJ_LIVE_EXAMPLES"), "true")) {
  catalogue <- list_boj_bulk_files("en", max_age = 3600,
    cache_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "readboj-live-example-cache"),
    timeout = 10, retries = 0L, wait = 0, max_bytes = 2 * 1024^2,
    deadline = Sys.time() + 30)
  ids <- catalogue$id[catalogue$role == "data_archive"]
  if (length(ids)) {
    archive <- download_boj_bulk(ids[[1L]],
      cache_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "readboj-live-example-cache"),
      max_age = 3600, timeout = 10, retries = 0L, wait = 0,
      max_bytes = 64 * 1024^2, deadline = Sys.time() + 45)
    print(archive)
  }
} else {
  message("Set READBOJ_LIVE_EXAMPLES=true to run this live example.")
}
#> Set READBOJ_LIVE_EXAMPLES=true to run this live example.
